Draw what this repository claims, and the evidence under it, as a Mermaid diagram on stdout (construct graph v<version>)

USAGE construct graph [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --dir=<dir>    Target directory (Default: .)                                   
      --plain    No colors, no lore (CI-friendly) (Default: false)               
     --johnny    Wake up, Netrunner. (Default: false)                            
  --out=<out>    Also write one self-contained HTML file rendering the same graph
